verdict.rationale: BILL's docs confirm configurable approval policies ("Set custom approval policies", and AP bill approval policies that control who must approve and when), which is the closest evidence to approval chains, but this is scoped to AP bills rather than explicitly to Spend & Expense card/expense workflows. Missing for 10: explicit multi-step chain configuration (manager → budget owner → finance), delegation of approval authority, and escalation logic when an approver fails to act.
